summary: An owner authorization (554) is accepted only as a verified reply to the exact request email: the request email's Microsoft 365 Internet message id and conversation id are recorded once when it is sent (owner_authorization_sent; an unsent request cannot be authorized), and owner_authorization_record requires the reply's In-Reply-To or References to name that message, the same conversation id, From and Sender both the owner, and Exchange's authenticated-inside-the-tenant stamp (AuthAs Internal with AuthSource and AuthMechanism). The stored authorization shape requires the same evidence. Only owner_authorizations changes; no row changes.

preflight.name: owner_authorizations exists (554 applied) and 555 is not
preflight.sql: SELECT ((SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'owner_authorizations') * 10 + (SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'public' AND table_name = 'owner_authorizations' AND column_name = 'request_message_id'))::int

preflight.name: no owner authorization has been authorized yet (the stricter evidence applies to all)
preflight.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM owner_authorizations WHERE status <> 'requested' OR evidence IS NOT NULL

expected_changes: owner_authorizations gains request_message_id, request_conversation_id, request_sent_at (written once by owner_authorization_sent).

owner_authorization_record requires a verified reply to that exact email (In-Reply-To/References + conversation id), From and Sender = the owner, and AuthAs Internal with AuthSource and AuthMechanism; the authorized-shape CHECK requires the same.

verify.name: the authorized shape requires the reply relationship and the authenticated identity
verify.sql: SELECT count(*)::int FROM pg_constraint WHERE conname = 'owner_authorizations_authorized_shape' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%request_message_id%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%auth_mechanism%' AND pg_get_constraintdef(oid) LIKE '%conversation_id%'

verify.name: owner_authorization_sent exists and is not executable by authenticated users
verify.sql: SELECT (count(*) * 10 + count(*) FILTER (WHERE has_function_privilege('authenticated', oid, 'EXECUTE')))::int FROM pg_proc WHERE proname = 'owner_authorization_sent'
